People around Nina often share different ideas about the green hill. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. The plant garden has become an important part of daily life. Also, a bird flies over the house.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Nina plans to study art harder this term. On Saturday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. In fact, july is very hot here.
Nina prefers sunny weather when running in the bookstore. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The experience taught Nina more than any book could. Pricking out needs a steady hand.
Nina thanked Max for the honest advice. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. In fact, the tiger is a top predator.
Max advised Nina to try drawing as a new hobby. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening.
